purpose: Introduce a lookup reference for layouts, snippets and page settings, with separate routes for everyday editing and migration.
expected_next_action: Look up the relevant reference entry on this page; use the migration mapping when moving existing content.

findings.exact_quote: Use this page to look up a layout, snippet or page setting.
findings.concern: Clearly establishes reference intent, but the opening supplies no exact option names, defaults or version restrictions. Whether those are available requires checking the reference entries.

findings.exact_quote: A **layout** is a page design; **front matter** is the settings block between `---` lines at the top of a content file.
findings.concern: Defines layout and front matter, while leaving snippet undefined in this excerpt.

findings.exact_quote:
Moving existing posts or pages? Use the
[migration front matter mapping](./46-migration-fields#layouts-and-page-front-matter).
findings.concern: Explicitly routes migration readers to a front matter mapping; its coverage cannot be assessed from this opening.

uncertainties: The excerpt does not show how reference entries are organized or located.
Option syntax, defaults and version restrictions are not shown; their absence from the opening does not establish their absence from the page.
